name: Discipleship
overview: Discipleship, as revealed in Scripture, calls believers to visibly reflect Christ's light in the world, standing boldly as a city on a hill. It demands a public confession of faith, with the promise of Christ's acknowledgment before the Father for those who confess Him, and denial for those who reject Him. Moreover, discipleship involves significant cost and division, as Christ warns that following Him may bring conflict even within one’s own family, underscoring the serious tests and sacrifices inherent in true commitment.
